name: Joint Path Vertex Sampling
definition: A method to construct a full path by connecting a light subpath endpoint 'a' and an eye subpath endpoint 'd' via a connection subpath with two new vertices 'b' and 'c', involving 3 random decisions (direction and distance from d, direction from c).
summary: Joint Path Vertex Sampling connects light and eye subpaths using three random decisions to reduce variance in participating media.
